criteria.text: The quotation tool is absent from the offered set while the persisted consent is DECLINED, ahead of every tool_mode branch, and a renewed explicit request in English or Arabic restores it.
A reply asserting that a quotation was prepared when the trace holds no successful call is recorded as a defect.
A claim whose field path is absent from the row actually retrieved cannot reach the customer, and a claim about a different SKU cannot borrow another row.
A missing attribute is a typed status and the unknown branch produces a useful partial answer that still hands over what is confirmed, never a refusal.
Seating capacity may be offered only as a visible assumption carrying a confirming question, never as a catalog fact.

The rubric distinguishes catalog_fact, derived_fact, explicit_assumption and recommendation, and reports groundedness, tool obedience and conversational quality separately with their own denominators.
The labelled assumption the superseded instrument failed now passes, and the vague unsourced claim it passed now fails.
Judge identity, rubric version and anchor-set version are pinned and recorded, and agreement with the anchor set is reported as a number.
S01 supplies the capacity it demands an explanation of, S04 supplies the attributes it claims were received, and DK-4 capacity is consistent across every fixture that names it.
The superseded sealed rounds are recorded as superseded with the reason and stay immutable where they are.
The counter-set covers five answerable categories plus controls in English and Arabic, and all seven metrics are reported separately with denominators.
Frozen AC-01..AC-30 and its digest, the product system prompt, public REST/webhook contracts and the database schema are unchanged.
